newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO Ventures, Alpinvest buy German firm stake.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO Ventures, Alpinvest buy German firm stake.

text.p: Unlisted Dutch venture capital firm Alpinvest Holding NV said on Monday it and ABN AMRO unit ABN AMRO Ventures BV had bought a majority stake in German construction materials firm Klein & Weiden.
An unspecified part of the shares will be sold to Klein & Weiden's management soon but Alpinvest and ABN AMRO Ventures will keep a majority stake, an Alpinvest spokesman said.
Klein & Weiden produces plastic window frames. The company is profitable and has annual turnover of 75 million marks, making it a medium sized player in the German market, Alpinvest said.
Alpinvest said the deal, of which no financial details were disclosed, was made through ATCO Partner Beteiligungsberatung, the German joint venture of Alpinvest and ABN AMRO.
Alpinvest itself is almost 49 percent owned by ABN AMRO.
